'''1999 GenCon Open''' was a Decipher-era constructed event. Published lists from this event are the 60s Decipher posted on Deck Designs.

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Dates:''' 7 August 1999<ref name="tr-d13" />
* '''Players:''' 152<ref name="tr-d13" />
* '''Site:''' Gen Con, Milwaukee, Wisconsin<ref name="tr-d13" />

== Discrepancies ==

Where a source disagrees with the record on this page, the page keeps the record and notes the difference here.

* Mike Fitzgerald's report names the winner 'Nick Reisch'; the hub and Jim Li's report give Nathan (Nate) Reisch.<ref name="tr-d13" />
* Mike Fitzgerald and Jim Li report their round-4 game differently: Fitzgerald won by 5, Li says he lost by 4.<ref name="tr-d13" />
* Jim Li says he lost his round-4 game to Mike Fitzgerald by 4; Fitzgerald's report says he won it by 5.<ref name="tr-d29" />
